note: Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003). Its New Testament is on disk (ebible mirror gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/amh_amh); it carries no Old Testament, so OT quotations are self_rendered in the 1962 register.
The mirror lacks some verses or holds them under a neighbouring number (e.g. 1 Peter 1:16, Ephesians 3:15-16, 2 Corinthians 6:17); those quotations are self_rendered.
